name: ask-twice
description: A 9:16 stick-figure short rendered from code, with a sound-effect mix

scripts.walktest: for m in heavy forced run walk; do node scripts/render.js --test walk --mood $m && node scripts/render.js --test walk --mood $m --track; done
scripts.build: node scripts/check.js && node scripts/render.js && node scripts/mix.js
